links.outcome: Underskilling and overskilling bias of surgical AI across surgeon sub-cohorts
links.effect: SAIS exhibited underskilling and overskilling bias at different rates across surgeon sub-cohorts; no numeric rates in the abstract.
links.quote: We show that SAIS exhibits an underskilling bias, erroneously downgrading surgical performance, and an overskilling bias, erroneously upgrading surgical performance, at different rates across surgeon sub-cohorts.

links.outcome: Effect of bias mitigation strategies on subgroup bias and overall AI performance
links.effect: Baseline strategies mitigated bias inconsistently, whereas TWIX mitigated underskilling and overskilling bias while also improving performance across hospitals.
links.quote: We show that whereas baseline strategies inconsistently mitigate algorithmic bias, TWIX can effectively mitigate the underskilling and overskilling bias while simultaneously improving the performance of these AI systems across hospitals.

unlisted_practices: Training AI to produce human-expert-style visual explanations (TWIX) to mitigate algorithmic bias

screen.reason: Evaluates a bias mitigation strategy (teaching surgical AI to provide human-aligned visual explanations) on multi-hospital surgical video datasets for surgeon skill assessment.

primary.practice: human visual explanation grounding to mitigate bias
